description: Implementation of an Opus audio decoder class, including initialization, decoding, resetting, and teardown logic, with external dependencies on opus library functions and internal handling of audio buffers.

classes.name: OpusAudioDecoder
classes.description: A class that handles decoding of Opus audio streams, managing decoder state, buffers, and callbacks.

classes.name: DecodedAudio
classes.description: A reference-counted class representing decoded audio data.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets up output and error callbacks for the decoder.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Decodes input buffers, managing pending buffers and invoking callbacks.

methods.name: DecodePendingBuffers
methods.description: Processes queued input buffers for decoding.

methods.name: DecodeInternal
methods.description: Performs the actual decoding of a single input buffer using opus library functions.

methods.name: WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals the end of the stream, adding EOS marker to the decoded audio queue.

methods.name: InitializeCodec
methods.description: Creates and initializes the opus multistream decoder based on channel info.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Retrieves decoded audio data and sample rate.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the decoder state and clears buffers.

methods.name: is_valid
methods.description: Checks if the decoder instance is valid.

methods.name: GetSampleType
methods.description: Returns the sample type used by the decoder (int16 or float32).
